Anhand historischer Aufnahmen und Geschichten erfahren wir, wie sich die Gemeinde im Laufe der Jahrzehnte verändert hat und was vom früheren Ortsleben bis heute geblieben ist. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: szene münchen
programme.desc: Roter Teppich oder kleine Premiere, digitaler Star oder Brettl-Kabarettist – die Szene mit Alexander Onken und Aurora Berisha ist mit Schauspielern, Künstlern, Sängern und Promis eng verbandelt. Neue Filme, Videos und Produktionen stellen wir als Erste vor – bunt, flippig und witzig! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lejeune
programme.desc: Hochspannung mit Barry Werkmeister: Ein Kandidat, 30 Minuten, eintausend Euro – wer schnell und gründlich rechnet, hat hier die allerbesten Chancen! Und so funktionierts: Barry sucht sich einen Laden aus und dann einen Mitspieler. Wenn der Kandidat in 30 Minuten Waren im Wert von genau eintausend Euro in seinem Einkaufswagen hat, darf er alles mitnehmen. Aber eben nur, wenn die Rechnung auf den Cent genau ausgeht! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Schaufenster
programme.desc: Sie würden gerne wissen, was in der Shopping-Szene alles neu und spannend ist? Keine Sorge – es entgeht Ihnen nichts! Unsere Moderatoren Sandra Koltai und Christopher Gogg werfen mit Ihnen einen Blick auf brandneue Angebote, peppige Trends und empfehlenswerte Shops – schauen Sie rein! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: München tut gut
programme.desc: München tut gut soll ein positives Lebensgefühl erzeugen und ist eine wöchentliche Sendung mit Reportage-Elementen. Das Format soll aufklären, inspirieren und die positiven Seiten des Lebens in den Mittelpunkt rücken. München tut gut berichtet über alltagsnahe Themen und aktuelle Trends mit Wohlfühlcharakter. Ziel des Formats ist es, den Zuschauern einen Impuls und vor allem einen Nutzen zu vermitteln. Es kann so einfach sein, sich selbst und anderen etwas Gutes zu tun. Manchmal fehlt nur ein ganz kleiner Impuls und genau den möchten wir jede Woche wieder aufs Neue finden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: münchen heute
programme.desc: Die aktuellen Nachrichten für München und das Umland kurz und prägnant zusammengefasst. Von Montag bis Freitag präsentieren wir täglich in 15 Minuten die wichtigsten Neuigkeiten aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sozialem, Sport und Kultur. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Münchner Stadtrundgang
programme.desc: Natürlich kann man in München einfach von einem Ort zum anderen gehen – schnell und ohne sich umzuschauen. Kult-Moderator Christopher Griebel kann das nicht: Immer wieder bleibt er an einem geschichtsträchtigen Ort hängen, an einem besonderen Menschen, in einer Alltagssituation, die er auf seine unvergleichliche Art begleitet und kommentiert – einmalig! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tierisch München
programme.desc: Hunde, Katzen, Schlangen, Kamele, Igel oder Echsen – Caro du Fresne hat ein Herz für alle Tiere! Und das zeigt sie uns: Auf Höfen rund um München, in den Tierheimen der Region, im Tierpark Hellabrunn. Wissenswertes zu Exoten finden Sie in Tierisch München genauso wie praktische Tipps und Tiere, die ein neues Zuhause suchen – vielleicht ja bei Ihnen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Culture Club
programme.desc: Es ist ein Spektakel aus Tanz, Musik und hoher Schauspielkunst. Kabuki ist hierzulande nur wenigen bekannt; in Japan kennt es wohl jeder.Ob Theater-, Holz-, Textil-, oder Japanliebhaber...Im Museum Fünf Kontinente haben die Kuratoren nun eine Ausstellung geschaffen, die alle Münchnerinnen und Münchner ansprechen soll. Von der Vielfältigkeit der Ausstellung hat sich mein Kollege Marksu Stampfl beeindrucken lassen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rätselhafte Phänomene
programme.desc: Spaniens berühmte Costa del Sol erstrahlt plötzlich weiß. Schneit es mitten im Sommer, oder stecken Menschen dahinter? Können Satellitenaufnahmen endlich enthüllen, wie El Chapo, einer der berüchtigtsten Drogenbarone der Welt, aus Mexikos Hochsicherheitsgefängnis entkommen konnte? programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier
programme.desc:
Infos zur Serie:

Schere, Stein und Papier teilen sich eine Wohnung – für beste Freunde doch selbstverständlich. Aber im Alltag ist das Zusammenleben dann doch nicht immer so einfach und so versinkt die WG regelmäßig im Chaos. 

Schere ist der lockere Spaßvogel, der selten etwas ernst nimmt und mit seinem Humor gerne die anderen auf die Palme bringt. Stein hingegen ist modebewusst, charmant und der gefühlvolle Ruhepol der Gruppe. Und dann gibt’s noch Papier – das kreative Genie, das mit seinen cleveren Erfindungen (fast) immer eine Lösung parat hat.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn dieser verrückten Show bekommt Patrick Star endlich seine eigene Bühne! Der liebenswerte, aber etwas chaotische Seeigel führt eine Talkshow, die genauso wild und unvorhersehbar ist wie er selbst. Mit seinen skurrilen Gästen, seinem schrägen Humor und jeder Menge Absurditäten wird die Show garantiert für Lacher sorgen – auch wenn nichts so läuft, wie es sollte!

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Im Kopf des Mörders
programme.desc: Landwirt Adrian Prout meldet sich im Jahr 2007 eine Woche nach dem Verschwinden seiner Ehefrau Kate bei der Polizei. Den Beamten, der Bevölkerung des englischen Dorfes Redmarley und seiner neuen Verlobten Debbie spielt er den verlassenen Ehemann vor. Viele Menschen halten ihn für unschuldig. Aber die Ermittler geben nicht auf, obwohl es keine Leiche gibt! Bis ein Lügendetektortest und Debbies Entschlossenheit die Wahrheit ans Licht bringen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Best of Fellner! Live – Die Kult-Talk-Show
Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Jana misstraut der Läuterung von Maurice, obwohl er sich bemüht, ehrlich zu erscheinen. Als er jedoch erfährt, dass Nathalie und Fabian nach Rotterdam gehen, stürzt ihn das erneut in die Krise. Er verspielt seine gesamte Barschaft. Als er am nächsten Morgen bei Nathalie die Diamantuhr von Fabians Mutter entdeckt, stiehlt er die Uhr und verspielt auch sie. Entsetzt müssen Jana und Nathalie erkennen, wie tief Maurice gesunken ist. Theo findet dank Carla eine Möglichkeit, die Mayo zu verbessern.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: In der Notaufnahme der Sachsenklinik stellt man bei Lars Wenke eine Ruptur der Speiseröhre fest, verursacht durch häufiges Übergeben. Der angegriffene Zustand des sportbesessenen Wenke lässt bei den Ärzten den Verdacht auf Bulimie aufkommen. Während die Verletzung behandelt wird, soll dies von Christina Buchmann psychologisch abgeklärt werden, aber der Patient blockt ab. Seine Ehefrau Martina wendet sich Hilfe suchend an Christina.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Klara Mersburg kommt als Patientin des Honorararztes Dr. Niedlich in die Klinik. Sie hat einen Tumor im Schultergelenk, den er mit einer teuren Chemotherapie behandeln will. Chefarzt Dr. Roland Heilmann ist von der Wirksamkeit der Therapie nicht überzeugt und wirft Niedlich vor, er hätte nicht einmal eine klare Diagnose. Dr. Vera Bader stellt sich vor Dr. Niedlich, sie erhofft sich durch Niedlichs zahlungskräftige Privatpatienten einen satten Gewinn für die Klinik.

programme.title: Die Kanzlei
programme.desc: Markus Gellert legt die Vertretung von Daniel Bienert nieder. Die TEDCOM hat ihm und Isa von Brede ein Video präsentiert, das eindeutig belegt, dass Benedikt Vollmer und nicht Daniel Bienert die App entwickelt hat. Eine Niederlage, die Gellert und Isa verärgert, die sie jedoch verschmerzen. Aber dann erscheint am folgenden Tag der Anwalt Gisbert Rottmann im Auftrag von Daniel Bienert in der Kanzlei.

programme.title: Die Kanzlei
programme.desc: Yasmin versucht, den vielen Neukunden gerecht zu werden, ohne ihre Familie und ihr Fernstudium, das sie gerade erst begonnen hat, zu vernachlässigen. Unter dieser Belastung bricht sie zusammen. Isa von Brede übernimmt die Vertretung von Marina Bischoff, die die Partneragentur `Hopefully Love' verklagen will. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Fernando Platas, clavadista olímpico y uno de los referentes más destacados del deporte mexicano. Desde sus primeros acercamientos a la natación y el patinaje acuático hasta convertirse en medallista olímpico y Panamericano, comparte su trayectoria marcada por disciplina, pasión y la constante búsqueda de la perfección. Fernando Platas habla sobre su preparación física y mental, la presión de las competencias internacionales, los Juegos Olímpicos de Barcelona, Atlanta y Atenas, y la importancia del apoyo de entrenadores y familiares. Entre anécdotas de sus clavados, aprendizajes y la construcción de un legado, dentro y fuera del deporte, nos ofrece una visión inspiradora de cómo la dedicación y la disciplina pueden formar no solo atletas, sino campeones de vida.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Paola Longoria, la máxima exponente del raquetbol mundial, para conocer su historia dentro y fuera de la cancha. Orgullosamente potosina y proveniente de una familia con fuerte arraigo deportivo. La entrevista recorre momentos clave de su trayectoria: desde sus primeros torneos, la conquista del US Open a los 18 años, su debut en los Juegos Panamericanos y los sacrificios que implicó mantenerse como la número uno del mundo. Paola también revela los desafíos mentales que ha enfrentado, la importancia del equilibrio emocional y cómo su equipo se convirtió en su segunda familia. Multifacética, disciplinada e inspiradora, Paola Longoria demuestra que el éxito es fruto de la pasión, la constancia y la visión a largo plazo.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: The People Across The Lake
programme.desc: A quiet community. A deadly secret. A courageous mother. A fight for their lives.

programme.title: Solo
programme.desc: An android killing machine begins to develop a human conscience.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: In a fantasy adventure, set in a world peopled by creatures of myth and magic, a prince embarks on a quest to find the magical Glaive and then rescues his young bride. Colwyn (Ken Marshall) is the leader of a mythical sword-and-sorcery group in pursuit of "the Beast" that has kidnaped his fiance, Lyssa (Lysette Anthony).

programme.title: Blue Thunder
programme.desc: A tough but straight-arrow cop battles a group of military and government elitists who have developed an extraordinary helicopter into the ultimate weapon. Edited for TV.

programme.title: It Happened To Jane
programme.desc: A Maine widow becomes a cause celebre when she sues a railroad tycoon over the loss of a valuable shipment of lobsters.

programme.title: Her Husband's Affairs
programme.desc: Trouble abounds when an advertising executive and his meddling, madcap wife team up to promote a crackpot inventor's new embalming fluid.

programme.title: Gidget Goes To Rome
programme.desc: Gidget, in Rome for a holiday, misinterprets attention she receives from a famous journalist.

programme.title: You Were Never Lovelier
programme.desc: Love story and musical set in Latin America.

programme.title: You Can't Take It With You
programme.desc: Lionel Barrymore is the eccentric patriarch of a clan of frustrated artists who decided 30 years earlier to retire from the rat race and use his fortune to encourage friends and family to pursue vocations that really interest them. At the center of his family is his granddaughter, Jean Arthur, who is carrying on a romance with her boss son, James Stewart.

programme.title: It Had To Be You
programme.desc: Ginger Rogers stars in this fanciful, screwball comedy as a young woman who has left three grooms standing at the altar...and is about to do it again! Cornel Wilde co-stars as the gentleman who tempts her away from the altar and then succeeds in marrying her himself.

programme.title: Decision At Sundown
programme.desc: A gunman is intent on revenge, going after the man who took off with his wife.

programme.title: 3:10 To Yuma

programme.title: The Big Gundown

programme.title: Headin' East

programme.title: Tamara
programme.desc: Tamara, guía de una galería de arte privada, es acusada de robar las joyas del renombrado coleccionista Dubrovsky. Indignado, él la busca para encararla, pero descubre que ella también es víctima de la estafa, no la villana que imaginaba. Entre ambos nace un romance. Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Human Nature vs. Modern Culture
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Approaching Trauma with Curiosity and Compassion
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - The Connection Between Health and Childhood Trauma
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Mom Didn't Fight for Me
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: I Don't Trust I'll Find Someone to Create a Life With

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.sub-title: La niña de los sueños rotos
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Leidy Johana García tuvo una hija con José Luis Mota, su primer novio, pero la relación terminó por problemas económicos. José Luis, incapaz de aceptar la separación de su hija, asesinó a golpes a Leidy en un ataque de ira. Fue capturado por la comunidad al intentar huir. Tras dos años y medio de juicio, fue condenado por homicidio simple a una pena mínima excarcelable y quedó en libertad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Julio Hermes formó una familia en Venadillo. Su hijo Jhon Andrés fue acusado de tener una relación incestuosa con su media hermana Angie Tatiana, quien quedó embarazada. En 2008, Angie desapareció y fue hallada muerta.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Helmuth Ángulo lleva 21 años buscando a sus padres, Gerardo Ángulo y Carmenza Castañeda, secuestrados por el Bloque Oriental de las FARC el 19 de abril de 2000 en la vía La Calera, Cundinamarca. Con 68 años cada uno, seis hijos y dieciocho nietos, la pareja nunca alcanzó a celebrar sus bodas de oro. Su calvario ha marcado media vida de dolor e incertidumbre para la familia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Miguel Rodríguez Moreno, hijo del excapo del Cartel de Cali Miguel Rodríguez Orejuela, escribe un libro sobre los 16 años que su padre y su tío Gilberto llevan presos en EE.UU. Ambos, ya ancianos, cumplen 30 años de condena por narcotráfico tras controlar el 80% de la cocaína exportada de Colombia. Sus familias buscan una sentencia anticipada por su delicada salud, antes de su liberación en 2029.

Rosa estalla en llanto sin poder asimilar que la mujer que odió toda la vida es su madre. Junior se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Marisela presiona a Adolfo para hacer abortar a Rosa. Erasto pierde movilidad en las piernas. Eustoquio continúa el plan de enloquecerlo. Rosalía intriga contra Rosa anunciando que jamás la aceptará como hermana en la familia Alamo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Guillermo le consulta a Marilda por una supuesta reconciliación con Cristóbal, después de haber escuchado una conversación entre él y Ana; ante la negación de Marilda, Guillermo encuentra una posibilidad para terminar de conquistar a Ana, porque entendió que, para Cristóbal, Ana sería segunda en su lista de amores. A pesar de ello, Cristóbal se convence que debe comprar el apartamento lindero al de su primo Guillermo, y accede a firmar los registros del préstamo bancario y así, consumar la compra, a pesar de que Ana decidió no mudarse al lado del hombre que le quita el sueño por las noches, y al que sólo lo ha visto dos veces en su vida,.

programme.title: Episodio 106
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis - el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie le pide explicaciones a Magdalena sobre las fotos que vio en el periódico de ella con Gabriel. Magdalena insiste en que es un malentendido, pero Angie no le cree. Gabriel va a la prensa y se ocupa de armar un escándalo por esto, pidiendo que se retracten públicamente por el artículo, pero Ricardo no planea hacerlo, y contraatacar nuevamente. Más tarde, Gabriel vuelve a su casa, y Angie lo espera enfurecida. Agustín le pregunta a Sofía sobre Magdalena y Gabriel, pero ella no le dice nada. Luego, Magdalena regresa a su casa, y cuando Agustín llega se pone romántico, hasta que finalmente le pregunta sobre su relación con Gabriel. Efraín llama a Valentina para citarla, pero su esposa llega, y él disimula que arregla una reunión de trabajo.

programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.desc: Live from Virginia Beach at the NCPA Virginia Regional 2025, the University of Virginia (UVA) faces off against High Point University in a crucial pool play match. With a bid to the National Championship in St. Louis on the line, these teams battle through a best-of-seven format.The episode kicks off with Women's Singles featuring Alexandra McDonald (UVA) and Sushi Bandaru (High Point), followed by an intense Men's Singles showdown between Eric Lee (UVA) and High Point's wild card, Freddy Ortmann. The action heats up in Men's Doubles with Cooper Duncan joining Ortmann, and Aiden Eggleston partnering with Lee. Watch for strategic mixed doubles play and see if High Point can force a sudden death dreambreaker.

Blending professional play with the spirited energy of Picklebowl, this match is a crowd favorite you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel

programme.title: Los Pitufos

programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer….

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío….

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties
programme.desc: With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse
programme.desc: Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
programme.desc: From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup
programme.desc: Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon
programme.desc: From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.sub-title: Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart
programme.desc: Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Seeking answers, Scott (Tyler Posey). Allison (Crystal Reed) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hear stories told by two unlikely narrators -- Peter (Ian Bohen) and Gerard (Michael Hogan) -- and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: As Allison (Crystal Reed) begins to suspect someone close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) conclude that Lydia's (Holland Roden) rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital during a powerful storm, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora's (Adelaide Kane) life.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: With the threat growing more personal and time running out, Scott (Tyler Posey) is forced to make a difficult choice to save family and friends while, at the same time, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) try to figure out how to save Cora.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: In the mid-season finale, under Deaton's advice, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends use an ancient but dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion (Gideon Emery) from achieving his sinister goal.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Weeks after saving the lives of their parents, Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer strange side effects from their ritual sacrifice. At the same time, the newly enlightened Sheriff Stilinski scours through old cases, looking for supernatural causes.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends race to figure out how to catch the Werecoyote Malia before it's hunted down and killed by her father. Meanwhile, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) are broken out of captivity by an unlikely ally.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: With Beacon Hills under curfew due to the power outage, the teens decide to throw a black light Halloween party while Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to get Kira (Arden Cho) to trust him in the midst of an attack by a strange new threat.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy, while Argent, Isaac and Allison search the past for answers to the shadow creatures. At the same time, Stiles, fearing he is going insane, reaches out to Melissa for help.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: After suffering from hallucinations for some time, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously disappears one night and it's up to Scott (Tyler Posey) and the gang to figure out whether he has been kidnapped…and if the Oni had anything to do with it.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously reappears, but is he himself? Meanwhile, Scott (Tyler Posey) must prevent a disaster and Lydia (Holland Roden) and Allison (Crystal Reed) seek help from an unlikely source...Peter Hale (Ian Bohen).

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: Stiles checks himself into a mental hospital named Echo House where he believes he will be safe from the Nogitsune. Will he be as far away from it as he thinks or closer than ever? Meanwhile Scott, Allison and Lydia look for a cure for him.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: While Allison, Derek, Chris and Sheriff Stilinski try to track down Nogitsune, Kira's mother tells the story of the Nogitsune she came to know. Meanwhile, the Nogitsune has taken complete control of Stiles and manages to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: Teen Wolf
programme.desc: With the Nogitsune still in control of their friend Stiles, Scott and Lydia find an unlikely ally in Peter Hale. Elsewhere, the effects of the Nogitsune have given Chris, Alison and Kira some trouble with four out-of-control werewolves.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade talks about some of the things he does to get - ready for the October 1st bow season opener in Mississippi, and we - show a couple doe hunts from the - first couple days of the season.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o Problema com Pinguins / Rusty e a Encrenca do Castelo de Areia
programme.desc: Rusty e a gangue devem levar uns pinguins até o parque de animais no dia mais quente do ano/Liam se inscreve num concurso de castelos de areia e perde seu projeto para uma gaivota ladra, Rusty e Ruby dão um jeito de trazê-lo de volta

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty Arrasa / Rusty e o Estouro dos Balões
programme.desc: Com a ajuda de Rusty e dos Bits, Ruby se apresenta no show de talentos de Sprocketville. / Quando Liam acidentalmente solta um balão gigante de hélio com ele dentro, Rusty e Ruby devem descobrir uma forma de levá-lo ao chão.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty Mergulha / Rusty e o Problema do Circo
programme.desc: Quando o tablet da Ruby vai parar no fundo do lago, Rusty mergulha para salvar o dia. / O circo está chegando e quando o motor do trem do circo para de funcionar, Rusty precisa colocá-lo de volta nos trilhos a tempo da noite de abertura.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty Marca o Lugar / Rusty e as Bits Loucas
programme.desc: Quando Rusty encontra um antigo mapa de pirata, a gangue acaba descobrindo muito mais do que um tesouro. / Quando as Bits vão parar dentro do replicador de partes do Rusty, a gangue acaba ficando com mais Bits do que esperava

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty Vai à Busca / Rusty e o Resgate Corajoso na Caverna
programme.desc: Quando a chave da cidade some, todos presumem que o Robôssauro a enterrou. Mas não demora até eles descobrirem a verdade. / Quando Sammy fica preso em uma caverna em um dia de exploração, Rusty salva o dia com uma grande ideia.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e as Bananas / Rusty e as Luzes Noturnas
programme.desc: Quando os macacos levados fogem da jaula no Parque de Animais, Rusty deve encontrar uma forma de levá-los de volta. / Quando as luzes da cidade se apagam após Ruby levar o Crush para dar uma divertida volta de avião.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a Bit na Floresta / Rusty e o Problema com o Brinquedo
programme.desc: Quando Crush se perde, Rusty inventa um aparelho voador noturno para encontrá-lo no escuro. / Quando Liam deixa seu animalzinho cair pela janela do trem, Rusty vai numa missão de salvação usando um aparato de aranha mecânica.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Melhor amigo do ninho do Rusty / Robô lançador do Rusty
programme.desc: Quando um pássaro raro constrói seu ninho num local perigoso e não é persuadido a se mover, Rusty e sua equipe reconstroem seu habitat. / Rusty e Ruby constroem uma máquina de lançar cupcakes que sai de controle.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Bit do espaço do Rusty / Rusty e o peixe que espirra
programme.desc: Quando as Bits encontram um satélite caído na garagem, Rusty tem que dar um jeito de fazer o bit do satélite voltar para sua casa no espaço! / Rusty e sua equipe devem levar um peixe doente para o Parque Natural para tratamento.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o trabalho na água / Rusty e a corrida do lixo
programme.desc: Quando o sr. Higgins enche uma bola de praia gigante com água em vez de ar, a equipe tem que levá-la até o lago sem estourá-la. / Rusty e Ruby ficam presos numa ilha quando competem para ver quem consegue pegar mais lixo no lago.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty na terra do Liam / Rusty, o garoto do aspirador
programme.desc: O Liam quer visitar um parque de diversões, mas obstáculos no caminho os impedem de chegar lá a tempo, então Rusty cria um parque temático. / Rusty constrói um grande aspirador para limpar a bagunça do Liam e encontrar sua chave de fendas!

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o capitão Sorvete / Pegador de criaturas do Rusty
programme.desc: Rusty e Ruby transformam o Sammy Sorvete no capitão Sorvete, um super-herói de sorvetes. / As crianças criam coragem para procurar uma criatura mística misteriosa, mas acabam descobrindo que é alguém próximo a elas.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty aprende a andar de patins / Aventura rústica do Rusty
programme.desc: Rusty constrói patins foguetes, mas eles cortam o gelo e acabam prendendo todos seus amigos em campos de gelo. / Ralph se perde na floresta, Rusty e Ruby se juntam à caçada. Todos eles se perdem e têm que descobrir como chegar em casa.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Animal mecânico do Rusty / Nave espacial do Rusty
programme.desc: Não importa qual seja o problema – um avião fora de controle, um circo parado ou um balão de ar quente fujão –, a criatividade sem limites do Rusty sempre encontra a solução.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a polícia de Bits / Rusty e o problema na barragem
programme.desc: Em um dia agitado, o oficial Carl precisa estar em muitos lugares ao mesmo tempo, então eles 'delegam' os Bits para ajudar.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o forte do Robôssauro/ Trator de esteira do Rusty
programme.desc: Quando Rusty, Ruby e Liam constroem um forte no qual Botasaur não se encaixa, ele foge para fazer seu próprio forte.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a invasão alienígena / Rusty e o carro corredor
programme.desc: As figuras de ação dos quadrinhos que Rusty criou para Liam ganham vida e se comportam exatamente como seus personagens conquistadores. Sammy e Rusty devem voltar para a cidade.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a competição de pêssegos / Rusty e o caos dos macacos
programme.desc: Ao ajudar a Chef Betty e Sammy a competir para o concurso de degustação de Peachy Keen, Rusty e Ruby devem encontrar uma maneira de fazê-los trabalhar juntos.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o projeto do animal de estimação / Rusty fica colado
programme.desc: Quando Botassauro se cansa de jogar, Rusty constrói para ele uma bateria maior - mas com ela vem MUITO mais energia!

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o mistério misterioso / Rusty e o jogo do quintal
programme.desc: O oficial Carl perde sua escultura da sorte. Rusty e Ruby devem encontrá-lo e convencer o policial Carl de que ele é um grande policial com ou sem a escultura.Rusty e Ruby ajudam Liam.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a aventura assustadora / Rusty perde as Bits
programme.desc: Rusty e Liam adoram quando o Sr. Higgins faz Sparkton Hills parecer assombrada com sua "Spooky Adventure", mas Ruby não admite que está com medo. Quando os bits escapam do pátio de reciclagem, Rusty e Ruby devem decifrar as pistas de Whirly.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o problema com a planta / Rusty e o atraso no dia de praia
programme.desc: Rusty transforma o Botassauro em um veículo para todos os tipos de terreno, para que seu amigo robótico possa rastrear todas as ervas daninhas. Rusty transforma o Botassauro no último gadget de dia de praia.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e a roupa dançante / Rusty e a abelhinha
programme.desc: O Sr. Higgins quer ir ao baile da cidade, mas acha que é um péssimo dançarino. Então Rusty e Ruby construíram um traje que dança para ele.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Robô-Rusty / Rusty e a catástrofe da gatinha
programme.desc: Rusty constrói uma versão de robô de si mesmo, então ele pode fazer duas coisas ao mesmo tempo. Rusty e Ruby constroem um amigo robótico para Botasaur, um Kittybot!

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Ruby e a aventura do cometa / Rusty e o incidente no lago
programme.desc: A Ruby quer ver um cometa passar e o Rusty vai fazer de tudo para que o desejo dela vire realidade! / Rusty e Ruby correm para consertar um cano de óleo que está vazando debaixo d’água antes que ele polua o lago e o torne inabitável.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty e o laboratório Rivet móvel
programme.desc: Quando o avião da guarda florestal cai em uma savana Rusty e Ruby percebem que precisam de um novo veículo que possa não só viajar grandes distâncias, mas também ajudá-los em suas construções. Portanto, nasce o laboratório Rivet móvel!

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Asia resolve que irá tentar atrapalhar o relacionamento entre Samantha e Daniel. Os moradores da casa do "Are You The One?" têm uma última chance de conseguirem amor, dinheiro e mais um dia para lidarem com as consequências do que fizeram.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez na história, o amor não tem limites e todos são uma opção para os 16 solteiros que desembarcam no Havaí para encontrar um amor e ganhar R$1,000,000.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: O paraíso já começa apresentar os primeiros sinais do inferno que está por vir. Um casal tem problemas devido a possibilidade de um relacionamento aberto. Triângulos amorosos começam a surgir na casa.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Depois do baile LGBTQ+, a casa fica literal e figurativamente uma bagunça. A bruxa está solta para dois casais da casa. Dionne Slay chega no recinto.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Um ménage a cinco agita a dinâmica. A tendência autodestrutiva do Justin ameaça sua relação com Max. Danny faz uma conexão.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa está determinada em descobrir qual dos casais é um par ideal. Jonathan está determinado em romper as barreiras do amor. Kai apronta na frente da Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Jonathan tenta fazer as pazes com Basit. Um casal se aproxima enquanto outros lutam para superar seus comportamentos tóxicos na relação.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Amigos e familiares colocam a casa abaixo. Jenna está dividida entre a estratégia e seu coração. Uma visita ao Quarto do Sexo tem consequências explosivas.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa tenta consertar os estragos causados pelo comportamento predatório do Kai que causou muita confusão. Remy tenta deixar seu passado de pegação pra trás para conquistar a Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Três casais encontram os seus pares ideais enquanto dois casais têm péssimas notícias. Justin e Max encontram a resposta que procuravam. Paige luta para derrubar suas barreiras.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Enquanto a casa luta para determinar os três últimos casais, uma pessoa tem certeza que sabe quem é o seu par. O novos pares ideais recém confirmados tentam se conhecer melhor.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Em sua última chance de ganhar o prêmio e sem mais cartas na manga, a casa precisa confiar que os seis atrasados seguirão seus corações para encontrar seus pares ideais. Amber está indecisa.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.sub-title: Quão Longe Você Iria Pelo Amor?
programme.desc: 22 solteiros de todo o mundo tentam encontrar o seu par ideal e ganhar 1 milhão de dólares.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.sub-title: Quão Longe Você Iria Pelo Amor? Parte 2
programme.desc: Uma noite, um casal se separa e segue para outros relacionamentos, enquanto outros casais pensam que acharam “a pessoa certa”.
